beats.say: You’ve seen her on screen, but she wrote a book at 19.
She started acting professionally at nine, debuting in the sitcom Rob in 2012.
From 2016 to 2018 she starred as Harley Diaz in Disney Channel’s Stuck in the Middle.
That teenage author now balances acting with writing, proving talent isn’t limited to the screen.
Her rise earned her spots on The Hollywood Reporter’s Power 100 in 2023 and Forbes 30 Under 30 in 2024.
Which Jenna Ortega achievement impressed you most?

facts: She began acting professionally at age nine.
She made her acting debut in the sitcom Rob in 2012.
She starred as Harley Diaz in the Disney Channel series Stuck in the Middle from 2016 to 2018.
In 2021, she made her writing debut with the book It's All Love: Reflections for Your Heart & Soul.
She was featured on The Hollywood Reporter's Power 100 list in 2023.
She appeared on the Forbes 30 Under 30 list in 2024.
